instrument: 25-game scored-run replica: all 25 public games, 7,200 s shared window, Franzen's priority gate

arm.change: startup trims, Franzen's W4A16 model served with REAP keep-448 routed experts (7.3 GiB freed for KV), 12 admitted streams

verdict: PASS on both gates. SERVING: harness tokens per second +13.7% with prefix-cache hits unchanged (93.1%) and KV p90 down from 0.84 to 0.65, so 12 streams now fit with their prefixes resident. AGENT: more levels at matched tokens per game (+9 at 75K, +12 at 100K), so pruning 64 experts per layer did not cost decision quality on these games. Total 122 levels against 92 (and 97 for the earlier control).
what_this_does_not_claim: One run per arm; the two controls differ by 5 levels, so the size of the gain is uncertain, but the mechanism (throughput up, cache intact, KV headroom) is measured directly. The hidden games are harder than the public 25.
